findings.title: schedule_type display conversion computed but not used in monitor context
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a local `config` copy on line 160 and, if present, replaces `config["schedule_type"]` with `monitor.get_schedule_type_display()` on line 162. The return dict on line 168 however emits `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the raw config) instead of the modified `config`, so the display conversion is dead code and the `config` variable is unused. The monitor context attached to issue occurrences therefore exposes the raw stored `schedule_type` value rather than the human-readable display string. (This logic was moved verbatim from `mark_failed.py`, but it is now in a new file and still wrong; either return `config` or drop the dead conversion block.)

findings.title: Renamed/relocated monitor helpers may break existing importers
findings.body: This PR renames `mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold`, moves the `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` into `sentry.monitors.types`, and moves/renames `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context` out of `mark_failed`. None of the other (test or production) modules that may import these symbols from their old locations are updated in this PR. Any importer of `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, or `SimpleCheckIn` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will fail to import. Confirm via grep/CI that all references were updated (and that tests import the new locations) before merging.
